title: JWC Environmental: Web leads auto-assigned | enCloud9
meta: How enCloud9 connected JWC Environmental's website leads to Dynamics 365 Sales and assigned them automatically by customer interest and geography.
answer: JWC Environmental, based in Santa Ana, has made municipal wastewater equipment since 1973. Dozens of website leads arrived daily and needed a more sophisticated lead management system. We worked with JWC's web development team to connect web leads to Dynamics 365 and assign them automatically. The team saves time and responds faster to opportunities.
facts: Dozens of daily website leads; ClickDimensions Marketing Automation already in place
outcomes: The team saves substantial time managing leads and contacts.
Automated lead distribution and assignment improved responsiveness to business opportunities.
chapters: JWC Environmental has made municipal wastewater equipment since 1973, offering waste reduction and screening solutions.
Leads arrived through its website every day, often in the dozens. JWC had already integrated ClickDimensions Marketing Automation, but it needed a more sophisticated lead management system.
We worked closely with JWC Environmental's web development team to connect web-generated leads to Microsoft Dynamics 365.
Leads are assigned automatically based on factors such as customer interests and geography.

JWC manages leads and contacts with far less effort, saving substantial time so the team can focus on high-value work. Automated lead distribution and assignment made the team more responsive to new business opportunities.
author: Kristin Caniglia
